name: gyc/info-minors
title: Info Under 18
description: Participant info: rules for each age group and how chaperones register minors

text.default: GYC Europe is for young people of all ages. If you are under 18, you need a responsible adult with you, and they register first.

default.title: Free
default.text: Free with a parent or guardian. No registration needed.

default.title: With a parent
default.text: Must come with a parent or legal guardian.

default.title: With a chaperone
default.text: Must come with a registered chaperone aged 21 or older.

note.default: How it works: the chaperone registers first, then uses "Add participant" to add each minor before paying. Chaperone and minor ticket types must match.
